data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'αλεξιος' (alexios), meaning 'defender' or 'helper'. In Christian tradition, this name is often associated with Saint Alexis, a martyr who was known for his charitable acts and selflessness. The name Alic carries the meaning “Defender of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alic usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.long_meaning: Originally derived from Old Norse álfr, meaning 'all father', which later evolved into Old English ælfric, meaning 'elf-ruler' or 'noble ruler'. The name Alic, however, is a variant of the Hebrew name עליק (Aleik), meaning 'happy, my God is joy'. The English meaning of the name Alic can also be derived from the Old English word alig, meaning 'happy, healthy, or kind'. In the English language, Alic is often pronounced as 'Al-ick'.
